params.prompt: Character model sheet for a prestige 2D animated biblical short film. Hand-painted illustration with confident gouache brushwork, simplified planes, clean readable silhouettes and two-tone cel shading with soft painted edges. Mature and dignified. Realistic adult proportions about seven heads tall, small heads, long limbs, real hands with fingers, restrained faces shaped by light and shadow. Never cartoonish, never big eyes, not a children's book, not photorealistic, not 3D. Plain ancient Near Eastern dress in wool and linen, muted earth colors: umber, clay, ash, undyed wool. Warm low light from the left, cool blue-grey shadow on the right. Each figure is complete from head to foot and separated from the others by generous empty space, nothing overlapping, no ground, no floor shadow, no props other than those stated. Transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no borders. Match the reference image exactly in painting style, brushwork, level of finish, light direction, proportions and color world. The sheet shows seven different ordinary people of ancient Israel, of varied ages and builds, no wounds and no blood, left to right, evenly spaced: 1. an older bearded man kneeling upright in side profile facing right, lifting a small bronze offering bowl with both hands, thin smoke not shown. 2. a middle-aged woman with a head covering kneeling upright in side profile facing right, holding a small bronze bowl at chest height. 3. a young man kneeling upright in side profile facing right, holding a small bronze bowl out in front of him, head slightly lowered. 4. an elderly woman with a head covering kneeling upright in side profile facing right, raising a small bronze bowl. 5. an exhausted man sitting on the ground in side profile facing right, leaning back on one arm, head lifted, gazing up and to the right. 6. a young woman half-kneeling in side profile facing right, one hand on the ground, face lifted, gazing up and to the right. 7. a grey-bearded man standing in side profile facing right, leaning on a short walking stick, head lifted, gazing up and to the right.
